FX-HEX-001.says: The settings as they start: Tile, radius 50, the centre in the middle, unlocked, no turn, no smearing. The middle tile holds all of this small drawing, so the picture is as it was.

FX-HEX-002.says: Radius 3, Tile: the hexagon round the middle repeated in a honeycomb, every tile the same.

FX-HEX-003.says: Radius 3, Fold Aligned: each tile six turned copies of one triangle of the middle.

FX-HEX-004.says: Radius 3, Fold Seamlessly: each tile six triangles, every other one mirrored, meeting their neighbours with no seam.

FX-HEX-005.says: Radius 3, Rotate 30: the honeycomb turned a twelfth round.

FX-HEX-006.says: Radius 3, the centre at 30 per cent across and 40 down: the tiles show the picture there, and the honeycomb starts there.

FX-HEX-007.says: FX-HEX-006 with Lock Center Tile on: the same picture in the tiles, the honeycomb started at the drawing's middle.

FX-HEX-008.says: Radius 3, Smearing 50: each tile shows the picture half way from the centre to its own place.

FX-HEX-009.says: Radius 3, Smearing 100, Tile, unlocked: every tile shows its own place, the picture as it was.

FX-HEX-010.says: Radius keyed from 2 at frame 0 to 6 at frame 4, linear: frame 2 is radius 4.

FX-HEX-011.says: Smearing keyed from 50 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end, radius 3: frame 2 would pass 100, is held at 100, and is FX-HEX-009.

FX-HEX-012.says: FX-HEX-002 moved three pixels right: the honeycomb moves with the drawing and the three columns left bare stay empty.

FX-HEX-013.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer, radius 3: the centre is the drawing's own, not the grown buffer's, and each tile is FX-HEX-002's.

FX-HEX-014.says: Radius 4, Fold Seamlessly, Rotate 15, the centre at 40, 60, Smearing 25: everything at once.

FX-HEX-015.says: Radius 0.5, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HEX-016.says: Radius 4001, above 4000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HEX-017.says: Render "honeycomb", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HEX-018.says: Lock Center Tile "maybe", neither on nor off. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HEX-019.says: Smearing 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HEX-020.says: Rotate 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HEX-021.says: Centre across 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-HEX-022.says: Radius keyed to 5000 at frame 4, above 4000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
